<thought>Based on the observed isotopic envelope—regular 1.003 Da spacing with a ~10 % M+1 peak and rapidly decreasing higher peaks—the pattern matches the natural 13C distribution of a carbon‑rich molecule. No characteristic 2 Da spacing or relative intensities indicative of Cl, Br, S, Si, etc., are present. Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified from the spectrum.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
